vintage: RECS 2020 (conducted 2020-21; microdata v7, tables final release March 2023)
caveats: Universe: occupied primary housing units in 2020 only; vacant, seasonal, second homes, military and group quarters excluded (EIA table footnote).
Year built is a householder-reported range. Characteristics describe the home as it is in 2020 and include later renovations (replacement roofs, windows, siding, heating equipment).
Sampling error: see se_pp (percentage points, jackknife). Cells with fewer than 30 sampled homes in the band x geography are suppressed.
EIA table footnote: Q = data withheld because RSE > 50% or fewer than 10 households in the reporting sample.

hc2_3_official_million_homes.note: Excerpt of EIA Table HC2.3 (millions of housing units, all unit types); Q = withheld.

meta.source: EIA 2020 Residential Energy Consumption Survey public microdata v7 (recs2020_public_v7.csv), https://www.eia.gov/consumption/residential/data/2020/index.php?view=microdata
meta.method: Weighted shares (NWEIGHT) among homes with a valid answer for the variable (not-applicable and missing excluded); SE in percentage points from 60 delete-a-group jackknife replicate weights, formula (R-1)/R*sum((rep-full)^2). Cells are [share_pct, se_pp, unweighted_sample_homes_in_category]. n = unweighted valid-answer homes in the band x geography; band suppressed when n<30.
meta.universe: Primary occupied US homes in 2020 (excludes vacant, seasonal, second homes, military, group quarters). Year built is a respondent-reported range; reflects the survivors only and the home as it is today (replacement roofs, windows, heating systems and siding are included).
meta.foundation_note: FOUND derived from CELLAR/CRAWL/CONCRETE flags (asked of single-family homes and some apartments in small buildings; not asked of mobile homes/most apartments).
